create_byte_track_tracker: create a ByteTrack tracker instance with custom confidence and matching thresholds for object tracking
run_byte_track_update: run ByteTrack update_with_detections to assign persistent tracker IDs to object detections
run_byte_track_reset: run ByteTrack reset to clear all tracked, lost, and removed tracks between video sequences
review_joint_tracks: review the joint_tracks function that merges two track lists without duplicate internal IDs
review_remove_duplicate_tracks: review the remove_duplicate_tracks function that eliminates overlapping tracks between tracked and lost lists
